name: Julian
household: Partner (30) + baby Sage (19 months); chosen family network for childcare
psychographics: Values sustainability and intellectual freedom. Finds joy in slow parenting philosophies but gets annoyed by performative 'natural living' trends.
current_solutions: BumGenius cloth diapers; the Libby app for library books; a secondhand Stokke Tripp Trapp high chair refinished from Craigslist.
frustration: At 3pm yesterday, tried to fold the Babyzen Yoyo2 stroller with one hand while holding a wriggling toddler; the canopy snapped off and rolled under a bookshelf, requiring a 10-minute rescue mission.
decision_style: researches sustainability credentials for hours; often settles for secondhand because new eco-options are too expensive
voice: formal yet peppered with library jargon ('circulation', 'metadata'); uses 'they/them' consistently; calm cadence even when stressed
